title: Vacuum-salt plant read from the patent drawing (US 5,366,514 FIG. 1, Muse vision)
source: US Patent 5,366,514 (Texas Brine Corp., 1994), FIG. 1 (scanned sheet 1 of 2) and Table I; illustrative ratings where the patent gives none
question: Can the plant make 3,000 short tons of salt per day instead of 2,500 (+20%)? What limits it first, and what is the most economical way to get there?
data_note: The drawing is the patent's own scanned FIG. 1, read by Muse vision; reference numerals are the patent's. Ratings marked illustrative are not from the patent.
